fastkcv: Fast Exact Cross-Validation for Global Kriging

Source: R/fastkcv-package.R
fastkcv-package.Rd

Fast, exact leave-one-out, k-fold and buffered leave-one-out cross-validation for global (unique neighborhood) simple, ordinary and universal kriging, computed from a single factorization of the covariance matrix (Dubrule (1983) doi:10.1007/BF01033232 ; Ginsbourger and Schärer (2024) doi:10.1080/10618600.2024.2353633 ). Takes the same inputs as 'gstat' krige.cv() and reproduces its output to numerical precision, with nugget effects, nested and anisotropic variogram models. Includes random, spatial block and k-means fold builders and summary statistics for comparing fold designs.
